notes.title: Update 0.7.2 (Leveling Units & More Music)
notes.content:
This update brings a fresh new way to balance the game flow. [b]Each playable unit can now reach up to level 5[/b], gaining stats upgrades: attack, damage, attack speed, or even attack range. 

Units that took part in many battles with you will be stronger and therefore more useful. The longer the game goes, you'll be able to find more and more high-level units in the shop, but at the same time, you'll meet more high-level enemies.

[h2]Update notes[/h2]

[h5]🆕 Units now gain levels[/h5]
- Units now gain experience and levels, up to level 5. 
- The current level is represented by a Star icon, starting at Lv.2: bronze, silver, gold, and platinum stars. 
- Hover over the unit to see which stats are improved (star icon), the current Exp and Exp to level up.
- Exp is shared between all units equally.
- Level up restores full health.

[h5]🆕 4 additional music tracks[/h5]
Each biome got an additional new music track!

[h5]Balance changes[/h5]
♻️ Get more gold with the initial team (+15 more).
♻️ Smaller armies in the early stages, High-level enemies in the late stages.
♻️ Spawn more healing shrines.
♻️ Final Battle only: reduce the chance for Skeletons, but they can be much stronger.
♻️ With the introduction of leveling units, the general balance changed a lot. Big units are easier to maintain, sticking to the same units is more rewarding, and hopefully, it brings more flexibility in army setups as every unit can get strong.

[h5]Other[/h5]
🆕 Hydra's wide attack area of effect is now visible on hover.
🪱 Adjust vertical screen edge scrolling to improve handling aspect ratios less wide than 16:9.
🪱 Restore Acolyte's name.

Thanks for playing!
Ada & Michał 
Irid Games

notes.title: Frostvale - Update 0.7 (New Biome)
notes.content:
This is the month of Frostvale, an entirely new biome! It's the biggest update so far and introduces the winter-themed realm, where you'll encounter new ice-cold Units, Locations, Environments, and Music. There's more, including a new Beginner Difficulty. Read more below 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678864/6b35a6ddcc6d9387ad72faf7e0fb52987eaaed93.png[/img]
[h1]New biome - Frostvale[/h1]
[b]Frostvale is a harsh land of ice, mountains, and brutal creatures. Only the toughest survive here.[/b]

[h4][b]7[/b] new units[/h4]
🆕 Kobold
🆕 Goat Berserk
🆕 Harpy (Pushback ability)
🆕 Ice Golem
🆕 Hydra (Wide Attack ability)
🆕 Werewolf (unique unit, Fury ability)
🆕 Dragon of Frostvale (boss)

📈 Now there are [b]38 [/b] different units in the game!

[h4]New Frostvale Locations[/h4]
🆕 Manor
🆕 Elemental Trouble
🆕 Werewolf Rescue
🆕 Frostvale Altar (boss)

[h4]Also[/h4]
🆕 New Frostvale music
🆕 New Ice-cold environments

[h4]Map generator[/h4]
🆕 With the addition of our fourth biome, the map generator has been updated to keep runs fresh and exciting. Each run now features three randomly selected biomes, leaving one biome unused. This ensures consistent world sizes while making every experience unique. Additionally, biomes will only include units native to their environment, though all units remain available for your use.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678864/55b461cf36e05292bcf7048d632d9643382e1b3b.png[/img]
[h4]New difficulty - Beginner[/h4]
🆕 To make starting easier, we’ve added Beginner difficulty, where the Buckle Up effect is reduced from 10% to 2% increase per stack, letting new players explore and learn at their own pace.

[h5]Damage Type Multipliers System (preview)[/h5]
🧊 Added Damage Type Multipliers System, which introduces resistances and vulnerabilities 
🧊 Added arrow up, down, and exclamation point icons next to damage numbers for hits affected by the increased, reduced, or critical damage.
🧊 Currently only used by the new Ice Dragon and Ice Golem units, with plans to be expanded in future updates

[h5]Quality of Life changes[/h5]
🆕 Added a shadow to the cursor to make it easier to see on light backgrounds
🆕 Units with a special ability now have a bolded title to hint at what the unit does without reading the details

[h5]Balance changes[/h5]
♻️ Lizard Warrior: Health 60 -> 80
♻️ Viper: Base Damage 12 -> 14
♻️ Cyclops: Health 450 -> 480, Exp value 60 -> 100
♻️ Hobgoblin: Health 180 -> 200, Gold value 25 -> 26
♻️ Radiant Beetle: Gold value 15 -> 13, Exp value 13 -> 12
♻️ Increased Book of Experience reward
♻️ Slightly reduced maximum map size

[h5]Other[/h5]
♻️ Arrived Heroes border is now golden in the win stats
♻️ Updated attack SFX for many units
♻️ Updated force applied after a kill for some units
♻️ Added a floor for Alchemist Merchant and the Crazy Alchemist
♻️ Updated some of the Tutorial texts

[h5]Bugfixes[/h5]
🪱 Fixed the game over & victory stats UI
🪱 Fixed issues caused by removing the shield granted by Nobles Shield.
🪱 Hiden Abyssynth damage info (since it was misleadingly 0)
🪱 Fixed issue with saving some events inside the Location area
🪱 Fixed Portal's bridge model not being aligned properly
🪱 Fixed additional spell slot having full alpha initially despite not having an assigned spell
🪱 Fixed upgrade icon not showing at Artifact Merchant
🪱 Enabled mipmaps for Blind and Debuff status effects
🪱 And more

[h4]Final Thoughts[/h4]
Please consider sharing your thoughts and feedback or simply click the thumb up/down button below. It truly warms our hearts.

Thank you for playing!
Michał & Ada - Irid Games

Other:

notes.title: Update 0.6.31 (Mid-run saves)
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, the Dethroned![/h2]

This highly requested functionality is finally here. Sorry to keep you waiting!

The update brings part 1 of roadmap's Update 1, which is [b]mid-run saves[/b] (saving during a game). We decided to split Update 1 to give you this feature as soon as possible because it was the most requested thing.

Now, whenever you quit via the Pause ('Esc') -> Quit, the game will save and can be continued later. A new 'Continue' button will then appear in the main menu. Remember that the roguelike "rules" are applicable, which means: you cannot load an old save; when you lose, you need to start over; starting a new game replaces the last save.

The game now also auto-saves after battles, so you are covered in case of crash/power loss/etc.

Keep in mind that the map can get really big and there are a lot of variations that could happen, so you might find some issues/differences after loading a game. Please let us know (on Steam forum or Discord) if you encounter such a thing.

Other than that we've sneaked in a few smaller bug fixes (eg. Covetwing taking more money than he should if you clicked the button more than once while in the replace artifact mode), but this update is focused on the saves.

Enjoy!
Michał

notes.title: Dethroned releases into EA in 26 hours!
notes.content:
[h3]We are excited to announce that Dethroned will be released into Early Access [b]in just 26 hours![/b][/h3]

In this kind of last-minute announcement, we'll tell you what to expect from the current version.

[h2]Early Access Content[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678864/ddebec34c878d9c35241672a363a3ec188997a26.jpg[/img]
The Early Access version is fully playable. You can beat and endlessly replay the game because of procedurally generated maps and two difficulty levels. Currently, there are 3 mages, 28 creatures, 25 artifacts with 4 different rarities, 7 spells, 3 biomes, and 18 locations. After beating the game by 3 mages, a stage-based, huge battle awaits you.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678864/90456a97e9c597c152f93c359a24de3c309e3f93.png[/img]
35 Steam achievements are ready for unlocking!

[h2]Difficulty[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678864/0a66d50aed2010fd2a1e297fd3e36597bb44ec62.png[/img]
[b]Hard difficulty not only makes the game more difficult [/b]- enemies get shields, ricochets, and bosses have more health, but it also gives you a positive change - an additional artifact slot! It opens new possibilities, while still being a challenge.



If you'd rather wait for the full release, it's planned for the end of 2024. Keep in mind though, that the price might increase as we add more content. [b]If you want to help us choose a direction for Dethroned, join our [url=https://discord.gg/rZE3MR3bUm]Discord[/url].[/b] We plan to do polls there to find out what you think we should prioritize.

To end this announcement, check out the release date reveal trailer:
[previewyoutube=5HWb4FWt1hc;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5HWb4FWt1hc[/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Big Demo Update: new languages, 6 artifacts, damage numbers and more!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings everyone![/h3]
The demo has been updated and there's a lot of changes. Let's get to it!

[h2]Localization[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678864/187114d3c532b14546d01ede812d6fd1dc78a533.png[/img]
Great news for people speaking:
[list]
[*][b]Polish[/b]
[*][b]Simplified Chinese[/b]
[*][b]Traditional Chinese[/b]
[/list]
The demo is now available in these languages! You can change the language in the settings.

[b]If you'd like to see your language in the game, please add Dethroned to your wishlist on Steam[/b] (we see from which countries you are) and if there is enough interest we'll add other ones.

[h2]New Artifacts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678864/470b4354c7cb3ab98f743cbcab1048ea79e392dd.png[/img]
We've come to the conclusion that the artifacts we had in the demo aren't a good representation of the various synergies you can achieve in Dethroned, so we've added [b]6 new ones[/b]:
[list][*] Ricochet Arrow
[*] Venomous Statuette
[*] Shockwave Hammer
[*] Cauldron
[*] Imperial Orb
[*] Infected Mushroom
[/list]They should allow you to experiment with different setups and synergies!
At the same time, we've removed Echoing Staff from the demo (but it'll be back in the full version) and Bloodthirster cannot be found in common events anymore, but there's still a way to get it.

[h2]Damage numbers & stat changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678864/9d649c33469592d1f33bd122c5f25e47f12c83f0.gif[/img]
You'll now precisely see how much damage you deal, how the new artifacts and buffs change the stats of your units, and most importantly - it's really satisfying to look at!
If it's not your cup of tea, you can always disable either (or both) damage numbers and stat changes popups in the settings.

[h2]And more![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678864/7d7a06395ded0bfafd0cc30609bd03835d0f1ed7.png[/img]
[list][*] You might notice the game looks a little different. Fields have better textures and lighting has been adjusted. We hope you like it!
[*] Some parts of the game have been optimized. For example, the game should load to gameplay faster.
[*] Tons of minor adjustments & bugfixes
[/list]

How do you like the new content and other changes? Let us know!

notes.title: Demo Update (v. 0.2.38)
notes.content:

- Reduced the delay before starting a battle and after all enemies are defeated.
- Visualize the time left for the Rains of Arrows cast during battle via an indicator below Elion's avatar.
- Added a popup after defeating one of the Eternal Rivals.
- Clicking on a Whirl of Transformation now displays a popup hinting there's a way to use it.
- Added slow-motion when dragging a unit during a battle.
- Slightly increased Demon Brute's Health and reduced Hobgoblin's Health.
- Slightly modified the Tutorial location, so it needs to be captured first before picking up the free units.
- Improved support for a widescreen aspect ratio.
- Decreased the texture size of multiple assets that didn't utilize their potential (the difference shouldn't be visually noticeable).
- Reduced the build size from 5.4 GB to 3.7 GB.
- Reduced loading time.
- Fixed a bug where a unit would sometimes refuse to fight during a battle.
- Fixed a bug where a unit was in the wrong position after a battle if it was dragged during the battle.

Side note - in the meantime, we're adding a lot of new content to the game, and we'll soon show what you can expect in the full release!
